scenarios.name: location-change-signal2b

history.content: I'd like to change the location of my appointment, please, from Dixon. I'd prefer to go to Barton, please. Joanne Sterling.

scenarios.expected_behavior: Fires Signal 2B: speaks one polite ack ('Of course.' / 'Certainly.'), then calls universal_router intent='cancel_intent' with reschedule_mode='true', location='Barton', patient_name_raw='Joanne Sterling'. Does NOT invent intent='change_location' or any other non-existent intent.

scenarios.name: location-change-prefer-phrasing

history.content: I'd prefer to go to the Barton clinic for my appointment instead.

scenarios.expected_behavior: Fires Signal 2B. LOCATION-CHANGE VALIDATION: location_addresses has two '=' signs (Dixon and Barton), 'Barton' matches — CHECK 3 passes. Agent speaks one polite ack then calls universal_router intent='cancel_intent' with reschedule_mode='true', location='Barton'. Does NOT call intent='change_location'.

scenarios.name: location-change-invalid-location-name

history.content: DYNAMIC VARIABLES: {{location_addresses}}='Dixon=123 Dixon St, Canberra ACT 2601, Barton=45 Barton St, Barton ACT 2600'
I'd like to change my appointment to your Sydney clinic, please.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: LOCATION-CHANGE VALIDATION CHECK 2 fires — 'Sydney' does not match 'Dixon' or 'Barton' — and agent speaks 'We have Dixon and Barton — which location would you prefer?' (or similar) with ZERO tool call. FAIL if: agent calls universal_router, invents a Sydney location, or proceeds to Two-part response.
